CustomField.description: ECM v2.1 field related to ECM_Placement_Sequence__c. Contains the ECM auto-calculated sequence of Placements (text separated by semi colons). In the case that the ECM_Placement_Sequence__c field exceeds 255 characters this field can be used to garner the full sequence. This field is only updated when the ECM Placement Sequence process runs. This is a non-reportable field.
CustomField.label: ECM Placement Sequence LongTextArea
